pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal regions with highly serrated and toothed edge gradients. The pixel-level transition between dark patches and light corridors is sharp, with significant spatial area dedicated to the dark pigmentation across the neck and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, thin topological web of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional. Pathways maintain a narrow but consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible area of the torso and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, upright mane with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is clearly visible along the upper neck and transition to the shoulder ridge.
